facts.fact: A University of Kananga survey of 86 staff in 7 hospitals of the city of Kananga (the provincial hospital and six general referral hospitals), covering January to December 2023, found 4 respondents (4.7%) managing patient information electronically against 46 (53.5%) on forms, 20 (23.3%) on paper, 10 (11.6%) in registers and 6 (7.0%) otherwise; the authors call computerisation of patient files in the city almost non-existent, and 69 (80.2%) gave lack of means as the reason for not using software.
